business: Maketia: SaaS to build a sales page for a digital product, sell it through your own SasPay link, and deliver the file by private link after the payment is confirmed
by_segment: Beginner creator: first product, small audience (under 2,000 followers)
Established creator: already sells by hand via WhatsApp + mobile money, 2,000-50,000 followers
Trainer, coach or small agency with regular sales
why_not: I have one product and I have not sold anything yet, so the free plan with 1 page and 1 product covers me. 9 900 FCFA a month is about 7% of what I earn, and I won't pay that before my first sales come in.

I'd start on the free page with my best e-book and see if it brings more sales than my WhatsApp. I still confirm every payment by hand, same as now, so I won't pay 9 900 a month until the free page proves it earns that back.

Je vends déjà sur Selar et ça marche : le client paie et reçoit son fichier tout seul, même quand je suis au boulot. Avec Maketia je devrais confirmer chaque paiement à la main et envoyer le lien moi-même, c'est un pas en arrière, pas un gain.

My clients already order on WhatsApp and pay by mobile money, and I send the PDF myself. With Maketia I would still confirm each payment by hand and send the link, plus open a SasPay account and learn an editor, so for me it is more work, not less.

I lost a sale last month because I was slow sending the file, and with Maketia I still have to confirm each payment and send the link myself. My current platform already gives me a sales page, so switching for the same manual work makes no sense.

My problem is sending the file fast, and here I still have to confirm each payment by hand and send the link myself, so it is the same delay as WhatsApp. I would try the free page for one product, but I will not pay 9 900 FCFA a month for that.

I don't know SasPay and I don't have an account there, and my clients pay me by mobile money on WhatsApp. I'd still have to confirm each payment and send the link by hand, so for one e-book I'd stay with WhatsApp, and 9 900 FCFA a month is too much for me.
